segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: A little girl is reaching for her brother to give her a cookie.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: The stool is falling over. The boy has taken the lid off the cookie jar. His cookie in his left hand is reaching with his right hand for one.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: Mother is drying the dishes. The water is flowing, running and flowing out of the sink. Mother is frowning.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: There's nothing going on outside. There's just bushes. But the door is open.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: The girl looks like she's laughing.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: Hey, a lady standing in the water.
